name: Germany, StVO sections 8 and 9 (right-hand traffic)
status: draft: written from the statute as I recall it, not checked against the current text and not validated on any data. Confirm with a local traffic-law expert before using results.
notes: Section 8(1): at a junction without priority signs the vehicle from the right has priority (rechts vor links).
Section 9(3): a vehicle that turns across the oncoming lane lets oncoming vehicles pass.
A stop or give-way sign gives priority to the cross road: that is the two-way stop rule in the engine.
